verdict.rationale: New Relic documents a NerdGraph API explorer for experimenting with its GraphQL API (new-relic-docs-20), which functions as an interactive, runnable reference for that API, but there's no evidence of a broader interactive API reference (e.g., REST API explorer/Swagger UI) covering the full platform, and probes show no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt exposed. Missing for 10: a comprehensive interactive reference across all New Relic APIs (not just NerdGraph), OpenAPI/Swagger-based explorer, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the explorer's usability.
